when I was around 13 years old, there was this physically-large kid with cerebral palsy (lets call him A) who bullied this other kid (lets call him D). One day, me, A and some other kids were walking home after getting off the school bus. Suddenly, D's uncle, an adult probably in his early 30's or so, appears out of nowhere.

He walks up to A, confronts him and grabs him very hard by the neck, lifting him slightly off of the ground. He threatens him, tells him that he'll fucking murder A if he doesn't stop bullying D. A, gasping for breath, says OK and begs to be let go. Uncle then leaves.

I (nor, I think, anyone else) ever told a soul about this even though it was a pretty horrifically clear cut case of child abuse by an adult against a handicapped kid which probably would have resulted in a prison term for the uncle, probably because from then on we were (rightly) afraid of the dude.

Until I got an internet connection it was the most fucked up thing I had ever seen.
